title: #355 Enjoyable Things
prompt: People should sometimes do things that they do not enjoy doing, such as learning a new language. Do you agree or disagree with the statement?

promptSegments.text: People should sometimes do things that they do not enjoy doing, such as learning a new language.
Do you agree or disagree with the statement?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point argues that doing things we do not enjoy helps us grow by teaching us new skills and making us stronger.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point argues that doing things we do not enjoy helps us grow by teaching us new skills and making us stronger.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point argues that these activities help us think in new ways because they give us problems to solve.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point argues that these activities help us think in new ways because they give us problems to solve.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Forcing people to do things they dislike is not helpful for their happiness.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Forcing people to do things they dislike is not helpful for their happiness.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: We should choose our activities to keep our lives happy.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: We should choose our activities to keep our lives happy.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first advantage is that these activities help people grow personally, as trying things outside our comfort zone builds new skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first advantage is that these activities help people grow personally, as trying things outside our comfort zone builds new skills.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, these experiences improve our adaptability and mindset by teaching us to keep trying even when facing difficulty.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, these experiences improve our adaptability and mindset by teaching us to keep trying even when facing difficulty.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Forcing people to do things they dislike can actually hurt their motivation.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Forcing people to do things they dislike can actually hurt their motivation.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another reason is that learning should come from a personal desire.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another reason is that learning should come from a personal desire.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
